text: "My soul refuses to touch them; Such things are like loathsome food to me [sickening and repugnant].
"Is it that I have no help within myself, And that success and wisdom have been driven from me?
Or, 'Rescue me from the adversary's hand,' Or, 'Redeem me from the hand of the tyrants'?
"Is there injustice or malice on my tongue? Can my palate not discern what is destructive?
